            pl=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
    blocks={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['pixels']==16 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:

    # beam tip: rightmost w/g small node in player row
    tip=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'wGg' and n['pixels']<10:
            for p in n['boundary']:
                if pl and pl[0]<=p[0]<=pl[3] and p[1]>16:
                    tip=p[1] if tip is None else max(tip,p[1])
    print(tag,"player",pl,"tip",tip,blocks)

action(['RIGHT'])
snap("after R1")
action(['RIGHT'])
